reddit.title: Improving Performance: Reduced Costs for Flowing Water in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. Drying a cell now only refreshes its immediate surroundings, reducing script time for a 64×64 lake from 20 ms to 12 ms. This means a smoother experience as you build your Roman colony! For more details, check out our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
